desk-light-en.text: ⓘAt /start you choose Free or Restricted before the room is created. For a fleet admin, Free comes first and is recommended; Restricted is still a choice, and the tap is still required. Anyone else is offered Restricted only. Change it later in the room's Details → Permissions, or from General's contact-change card. Where the guard doesn't cover a room's AI tool or version, that tool runs with its normal permissions; only contact approval applies.

desk-dark-zh-TW.text: ⓘ執行 /start 時，房間建立前要選擇自由模式或受限模式。Fleet 管理員會先看到自由模式（建議），受限模式仍是一個按鈕，仍要點選。其他人只會看到受限模式。之後可在房間的詳細資訊 → 權限，或從 General 的聯絡變更卡片更改。若防護不涵蓋房間的 AI 工具或版本，該工具會以原本的權限執行，只有聯絡申請需要核准。
